title: Checkout mode's install points a set back at dev after bin/devbin use opt, against devbin's T5
objective: molt-dc's finding during 87d6 (27 Nov 2026): on a sleeve whose utilz source is checkout, molt install links with molt_link, which removes a link that points somewhere else. So after bin/devbin use opt, molt install points the set back at dev. devbin's dev, opt and brew contract (T5) says that nothing else repoints. It starts in the next Molt round.
